definitions.explanation: an administrative unit within a Japanese university's graduate school, roughly equivalent to a graduate department or faculty in Western universities

examples.japanese: {工学|こうがく}{研究科|けんきゅうか}に{進学|しんがく}した。
examples.english: I entered the Graduate School of Engineering.

examples.japanese: {研究科|けんきゅうか}の{入試|にゅうし}は{来月|らいげつ}に{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The graduate school entrance exams will be held next month.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}には{人文科学|じんぶんかがく}{研究科|けんきゅうか}と{自然科学|しぜんかがく}{研究科|けんきゅうか}があり、{博士課程|はくしかてい}まで{設置|せっち}されている。
examples.english: This university has graduate divisions for humanities and natural sciences, with doctoral programs established in both.

notes:
In the Japanese university system, {研究科|けんきゅうか} is the graduate-level counterpart of {学部|がくぶ} (undergraduate faculty/department). It is the organizational unit under the {大学院|だいがくいん} (graduate school). Official names typically follow the pattern "X{研究科|けんきゅうか}" where X is the field of study.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大学院|だいがくいん}{研究科|けんきゅうか}: graduate school division
- {法学|ほうがく}{研究科|けんきゅうか}: Graduate School of Law
- {医学|いがく}{研究科|けんきゅうか}: Graduate School of Medicine
- {研究科|けんきゅうか}{長|ちょう}: dean of a graduate division

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {学部|がくぶ}: undergraduate faculty — the undergraduate-level equivalent
- {大学院|だいがくいん}: graduate school — the broader institution containing multiple {研究科|けんきゅうか}
- {学科|がっか}: department; course of study — a smaller division within a {学部|がくぶ} or {研究科|けんきゅうか}
